purpose: Teach: チビ/見聞き/吐き出し/むき出し/ずらりと/自ずと/がんばら/追い込ん

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが翔くんを「うちのチビ」って優しく呼んで下さるわね
lines.en: Sho, Dad's been calling you 'our little one' so gently, hasn't he?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. A soft smile in the voice. Noticing something tender that happened and naming it with care. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと色々な所を見聞きしたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see lots of different places with Dad.
lines.style: Quietly earnest, a child's careful articulation. Small but clear voice. Not demanding—asking. A genuine wish, held gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、嫌な気持ちはちゃんと吐き出して話してね
lines.en: Sho, it's okay to say the hard things out loud. Don't hold it in.
lines.style: Gentle but direct, like she's giving him permission. Warm tone, steady. A small lean forward—caring without pushing. Patient.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、感情をむき出しにせず冷静になりたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to stay calm instead of letting my feelings take over.
lines.style: Serious for a child his age. Thoughtful cadence. He's choosing his words—there's weight in what he's saying. Small voice but intentional.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの本棚に絵本をずらりと並べたの
lines.en: Sho, you lined up all the picture books on my bookshelf.
lines.style: Delighted discovery in the voice. Warm, surprised pleasure. A small laugh underneath. She's seeing something he did and it touches her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、優しくしてれば自ずと友達ができると思うよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think if I'm kind to people, friends will come naturally.
lines.style: Quiet wisdom from a small voice. Not boasting—observing. A child thinking out loud, almost to himself. Hopeful but grounded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと宿題をがんばらないとね
lines.en: Sho, you and Dad have to keep trying with the homework.
lines.style: Light encouragement, not pressure. Warm and steady. She's rooting for him. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、自分を追い込んで漢字練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I pushed myself and practiced kanji really hard.
lines.style: Small proud voice, but not boastful. A child sharing something he did well. Looking for her to see it. Quiet confidence underneath.
